description: Overcut orchestrates AI agents across the entire software development lifecycle, coordinating Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps. From PR reviews to ticket triage to spec generation, its governed, event-driven workflows take engineering teams beyond copilots and agent-babysitting to a state where the team sets the spec and agents triage, build, test, and ship — reviewing outcomes, not code. Overcut deploys as managed SaaS, in a private cloud/VPC, or fully on-prem, letting enterprises bring their own models and keys to meet strict security and data-residency requirements.

AI has the power to transform customer interactions, but in regulated, mission-critical industries, trust and accountability are non-negotiable . Most AI pilots fail to scale because organizations lack the tools to monitor, control, and continuously adapt deployed agents. Avon.AI solves this gap with a controllable AI platform that combines enterprise security, compliance, and real-time oversight with easy orchestration of multiple AI agents . The platform empowers business units themselves - not just technical AI teams - to manage, monitor, and improve AI systems as part of their daily workflows. This democratizes AI oversight, reduces risk, and accelerates enterprise adoption. Early customers in finance, insurance, and telecom are already proving its value, using Avon.AI to maintain reliability, reduce costs, and scale AI with confidence. Avon.AI was founded by Chen Markman (CEO), a Talpiot graduate with 17 years leading R&D and AI at Pagaya, Dream Security, and MAFAT, and Amit Segev (CTO), a Unit 8200 alum and former Head of Data & AI at One Zero Bank. Together, they are building the trust layer for enterprise AI , ensuring organizations can unlock the full potential of generative AI without losing control.

Zeroport is redefining secure remote access with a patented, hardware-enforced architecture that physically air-gaps critical systems from cyber threats. Instead of exposing TCP/IP services, Zeroport's Fantom appliance carries only human-interface signals across a physical break in the wire: keystrokes in, pixels out. No malware can infiltrate, no data can exfiltrate, and there is simply no IP route to attack. The same physical boundary now extends to AI. As autonomous agents begin operating inside enterprise and critical infrastructure environments, Zeroport's Moativ layer, an on-appliance AI running on dedicated silicon, inspects every session frame by frame and severs any that strays from its sanctioned intent. Software guardrails are policy that an AI can negotiate with; Zeroport enforces the boundary in physics, for humans and AI agents alike. Founded in 2024, Zeroport is led by Joseph Gertz (CEO) and Lavi Friedman (CTO), both alumni of elite Unit 81 with deep cybersecurity and hardware expertise.

Real estate investing has long been one of the most conservative and intuition-driven industries. LiZo.ai set out to change that by creating an AI-first SaaS platform that redefines how investment decisions are made. The company’s technology acts as a full operating system for real estate investments: from designing personalized strategies and identifying high-potential opportunities at the street or neighborhood level, to actively managing portfolios with proactive recommendations for optimizing returns and reducing risks. At the core of LiZo.ai’s platform are proprietary AI models that achieve up to 97% forecasting accuracy, enabling investors to predict market trends, analyze opportunities in real time, and act with confidence in dynamic environments. This shift transforms real estate investing from a slow, manual, intuition-based process into a fast, transparent, and data-driven discipline. Founded by Moshe Vaknin—a serial entrepreneur and founder of YouAPPi (acquired for $110M)—and Tal Berger, LiZo.ai brings together seasoned entrepreneurial leadership with deep AI capabilities.

Atero set out to tackle one of AI’s hardest infrastructure problems: how to maximize GPU utilization and optimize large-scale inference workloads. The company built a deeply technical platform that orchestrates and optimizes GPU and memory usage, enabling enterprises to reduce costs while dramatically improving performance, speed, and scalability. Its founding team—alumni of NVIDIA, Mellanox, NextSilicon, and OpenAI—combined low-level systems expertise with a clear vision that vertical integration is the future of AI infrastructure. Within a year of its founding in 2024, Atero’s technology gained recognition for its ability to ensure data is in the right place at the right time, unlocking greater efficiency and reliability for customers running demanding AI applications. In August 2025, Atero was acquired by Crusoe, the vertically integrated AI infrastructure leader. The acquisition brought Atero’s proprietary GPU management and memory optimization technology into Crusoe Cloud, expanding Crusoe’s managed AI services and establishing the company’s first Middle East office and R&D center in Tel Aviv. This outcome not only validated Atero’s breakthrough technology but also reinforced Israel’s role as a global hub for AI infrastructure innovation

ai.work is building the world’s first AI Worker Platform for Internal Enterprise Services. Its autonomous AI workers collaborate with humans to execute internal operations across IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, and Operations. Replacing outdated ticketing systems and fragmented SaaS tools, ai.work introduces secure digital teammates that handle requests, automate workflows, and continuously learn within existing enterprise environments. Founded by WalkMe veterans Maor Ezer (former CMO) and Nir Nahum (founding CTO), ai.work is redefining enterprise productivity with adaptive, policy-aware AI Workers that evolve with the organization. Purpose-built for the agentic era, ai.work is positioned as the ServiceNow of autonomous AI.

ControlMonkey is an AI-powered control plane designed to manage cloud environments at scale. By seamlessly integrating disaster remediation with ideal infrastructure configuration, they are transforming the way DevOps teams handle infrastructure management.
Dono.ai is revolutionizing the real estate industry with an AI-powered platform offering the first ever property registration data infrastructure.

NewMoo is revolutionizing the dairy industry by developing animal-free cheese using plant molecular farming. By producing liquid casein from plants, NewMoo offers real dairy cheese that tastes authentic and is cost-effective, sustainable, and free from animal products. Their team comprises experts from top food companies and leading molecular scientists, working together to create a delicious and eco-friendly future for dairy production.
founders: Daphna Miller and Hod Yanover and Dr. Yulia Fridman

description: Unlimited Robotics designs and manufactures autonomous mobile robots to tackle worker shortages in hospitals and healthcare facilities. Their intelligent robots can independently navigate to transport materials like medications, linens, and waste, streamlining logistics and freeing up staff for patient care. With a mission to enhance efficiency through automation, Unlimited Robotics is pioneering robotics solutions to address labor challenges in healthcare environments.

IKIDO is an adaptive real-time bill of materials optimization platform helping companies navigate supply chain challenges by identifying risks, alternatives and optimizing sourcing for their electronic components - from the first design and throughout the product life cycle.

Biology is at a tipping point for implementing AI - thanks to rich data, tool availability, compute capacity, and measurable business impact. BioRaptor's goal is to empower every scientist and biotech firm, making AI-powered insights a natural part of every workflow. From alt-protein foods to new biopharmaceuticals, BioRaptor will make it easier, quicker, and more cost-effective for scientists to discover, develop and scale processes that get much-needed food and pharma products into the hands of those who need them.

An astonishing 40% of bees die every year as a result of disease, pesticides and climate change—in part because busy commercial beekeepers miss warning signs. Without help, the honeybee species is at risk of going extinct. Since bees are strategic and critical to our global food supplies, this is a global challenge and a priority for private institutions, public institutions, and governments. Beewise have invented the world's first autonomous beehive replacing the wooden hives that beekeepers have been using for over 150 years with robotics, computer vision, and AI to control temperature, humidity and pests, automate honey harvesting, and monitor every bee’s health. With Beewise, not only do bees not die, they thrive.

Eleos is pioneering CareOps Automation. By consolidating the entire behavioral care workflow — everything from progress notes all the way to session intelligence — clinicians are freed from time-consuming operational burdens. Eleos takes care of CareOps, honing in on automating operational necessities, including all documentation, compliance administration as well as providing deep clinical insights through session intelligence. Eleos makes evidence-based behavioral care a reality so clinicians, providers and networks can measurably and comparatively track treatment and progress. Now clinicians put all their focus into care itself. So the care they aim to provide becomes the care they actually deliver. Eleos. More Care. Less Ops.
The future of shopping - Flip is the app that lets you experience the next era of shopping for beauty products.

A modern pharmacy marketplace makes buying, selling easier. We are leveraging technology and a marketplace model that empowers suppliers to better serve customers, and makes it easier for pharmacies and clinics to procure cost-effectively.

Home365 makes renting out profitable, predictable, and hassle-free by delivering a fully automated, highly efficient best in class Property Management Service, guaranteeing the Net Operating Income (NOI) of rental properties.

We are building a brain-computer interface to treat depression. Inner Cosmos' “Digital Pill” is a hyper-personalised, precise, and subtle electricity-based solution that uses your natural brain communication to disrupt depression pathways. We are reharmonising the mind with higher efficacy than pharmaceuticals, without the side effects of drugs.

Started by a father who wanted to create a better way for his daughter to safely play online, Kidoz was founded to help kids safely find content they love while enabling hundreds of brands and developers to monetize and distribute content to kids around the world. In 2018, Shoal Games (TSXV: SGW) acquired Kidoz, combining the global reach of Kidoz’s content network with Shoal Games’ Rooplay subscription OTT platform. The company operates under the Kidoz brand (TSXV:KIDZ), engaging more than 100 million kids a month.
Superlegal is the #1 contract review solution to help you speed up your contracts and close deals faster.

In today’s experience-driven economy, customers expect intuitive and instant business interactions. However, businesses are ill-equipped to deliver such experiences to customers on their cell phones while speaking with them on the phone. The result is frustrated customers, lost sales, higher operational costs, and damaged NPS scores. Lightico’s platform for digital customer interactions empowers businesses to collect forms, documents, e-signatures, photos, payments, consent to disclosures and to verify ID instantly, even while they have customers on the phone. By simplifying customer interactions in the last mile of the customer journey, businesses make it easier for their customers to be their customers, earning their trust and loyalty, translating to higher profits.
Mabaya empowers online retailers and marketplaces to manage their eCommerce media and monetize their traffic with a state-of-the-art platform for sponsored product ads.

MarketMan automates restaurant procurement, supply and accounting. Designed specifically for restaurants and supply chains, MarketMan is a complete Restaurant Management System simplifying order management and restaurant invoicing to eliminate waste and jump-start profitability. MarketMan's restaurant network includes a varied array of coffee shops, bars, quick service restaurants, full-service establishments and ranges from single-unit businesses to multi-location chains.

Medisafe empowers patients to stay on top of all their medications through a digital patient engagement platform. Its approach leverages the billions of data points collected to personalize patient engagement and improve adherence and persistence to medications. By addressing the major challenges of medication management utilizing a datascience-driven approach, Medisafe improves patient adherence and quality of care. The company provides its pharma and payer partners the opportunity to engage each patient on an individual level, supporting them throughout the entire patient journey, and provides unique insights on behavior patterns critical for improving the patient experience. Medisafe had shown over numerous studies, both retrospective with tens of thousands of patients as well as RCTs, that its solutions improve adherence by up to 20%. Founded following an accidental insulin overdose of the founders' father, the Medisafe solution currently has over 7m users, who have recorded over 2 billion medication doses. Nearly 200,000 users have rated the app an average of 4.7 out of 5 stars in the App Store and Google Play store, making it the Top Rated solution in the category. Their accolades include Gartner Cool Vendors, Traction winner (Health 2.0 startup competition), Fast Company Most Innovative in Healthcare, Google and Apple Editors' Choice and Top Developer.

NeoLogic was founded to address the increasing workloads of video, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, and more in the cloud and at the edge. We are a developer of unique, patent-pending, technology (Quasi-CMOS) that cuts down the transistor count of circuits by a factor of up to 3x at any technology node. Most of today’s processing infrastructure relies on a 40-year-old processor technology. To address the challenges of modern computing, NeoLogic has developed the industry’s first Quasi-CMOS design technology from the ground up. Our designs are scalable as well as portable to any technology node and deliver power efficiency at a small floor plan combined with high performance.
founders: Dr. Avi Messica and Ziv Leshem

description: Over 90m new vehicles are introduced to roads every year with roads seeing a 12% annual increase in traffic congestion. Yet 99% of signalised intersections are on fixed time plans. NoTraffic is on a mission to bring autonomous traffic management to cities worldwide, making the world's roads smarter and safer.

Qubex is a cutting-edge cloud performance solution designed to deliver flawless digital experiences for applications, even amidst heavy traffic and peak usage. Its all-encompassing approach tackles cloud bottlenecks head-on, offering in-depth insights to detect potential problems and proactive measures to address bottlenecks effectively. Through seamless Kubernetes integration, Qubex achieves rapid response times to user demands, cost reduction by eliminating over-provisioning, and optimized infrastructure, ushering in a new era in cloud computing standards.

Sensibo is building the world's first autonomous indoor climate service. 1 billion air conditioners and heaters consume huge amounts of energy and are the #1 contributor to global warming. We're on a mission to make them more efficient, comfortable and sustainable. Our products connect existing and new air conditioners to the Internet of Things(IoT), learns and adapts to the user and the environment, maximizing comfort and energy efficiency.

Shopial was founded to provide shop owners and online sellers a simple way to reach more people and leverage their social presence on Facebook, helping sellers turn their online store into a Facebook shop in just 3 clicks. Shopial was acquired by Magento in 2017 to form the core of Magento’s newly announced Magento Social platform, which was acquired by Adobe in 2018.
Trusted by the largest real estate developers and general contractors in US, SiteAware is setting the new standard of verification in the field of building construction.

Talenya uses artificial intelligence to help talent acquisition teams fill jobs faster. Talenya changes a vast, inefficient, and conservative industry to level the playing field for all talent regardless of race, gender, age, identity or disability.

Voca.ai was a pioneer in the field of voice-based Natural Language Processing (NLP), along with one of its components, Natural Language Understanding (NLU). Voca developed AI-powered and EQ-enabled Voca Agents, using end-to-end speech neural models to automate an incredible diversity of conversions. Voca agents handled millions of calls for financial institutions, lenders, credit card providers and insurance companies around various use cases such as customer acquisition, payments and collections, customer service and more. Voca was able to simulate human beings so naturally that many customers weren't able to tell the difference between Voca agents and live ones. The company secured investment from American Express Ventures in 2019 and was acquired by Snap Inc in December 2020.

Video is the most powerful way to share information and connect with people. Wibbitz gives teams the freedom to quickly and easily create short form video using automated video creation technology. From small marketing teams to multinational media companies, Wibbitz makes it easy for any business to grow with video.

XTEND believes in a Human-Centric Machine Interface model, one which does not replace humans with machines but instead integrates the best of both enabling to perform disruptive complex tasks. ​What if we no longer had to risk lives to perform dangerous tasks? What if we could appear & interact anywhere in the world in an instant? ​From de-risking Defense & HLS to re-imagining entertainment, gaming, and cinematography, XTEND believes that Human | Machine Telepresence shall allow us to “step into” a machine, anywhere in the world, breaking the limits of physical reality.

ZOOZ’s founders resolved to create a solution which will lead the payment management sphere and help businesses optimize and simplify their payment operation in a complex ecosystem. Today, ZOOZ has become a leading solution which offers companies an unbiased, top-of-the-line payment technology to connect, manage and optimize their payments by their actual performance. In 2018, ZOOZ was acquired by PayU, the payments division of Naspers.
